summary: BCB Bancorp filed an 8-K reporting a routine underwritten common stock offering, not a special situation. On September 16, 2026, the Company and BCB Community Bank signed an underwriting agreement with Piper Sandler & Co. for up to 12,650,000 shares; the 11,000,000-share base offering and the full 1,650,000-share overallotment closed September 18, 2026, raising roughly $92.4M net ($79.6M before overallotment). The offering was made off an effective Form S-3 shelf via a September 16 prospectus supplement. No deal terms, premium, board recommendation, or risk-arb angle apply; watch only for dilutive capital deployment.
